answer: Sybil resistance follows from reputation decay: each contribution loses weight with an exponential half-life, so durable influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst. In the reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted paths; even a marble-sized sybil cluster has hollow, unreciprocated claims that cannot pass consensus. Trust may wander across links, but only supported endorsements propagate.
